svg.title: Figure 04 | Four-layer computational architecture
svg.desc: Proposed four-layer computational architecture for PVMouse 3.0: a versioned gene prior, a mouse-adapted cell reference, a hierarchical virtual organ, and a multi-organ model for joint state estimation, genetic perturbation responses and temporal updates. Both target-time expression and phenotype predictions and state trajectories belong to the initial MVP. Finer temporal resolution and additional perturbation types are subsequent extensions. The initial organs are brain, heart, liver, skeletal muscle and spleen in C57BL/6J mice. Dashed upward arrows show reference and calibration inputs; solid arrows show computational connections and prediction outputs. The construction sequence is described separately in Chapter 8. All illustrations and labels are editable native vectors.

svg.title: Evidence-weighted gene prior
svg.desc: A blue gene relationship network grouped into three softly shaded pathways, with evidence records and a DNA double helix.
